results.title: Mis Tres Animales
results.overview: Following the disappearance of a group of Catholic missionaries, Commander Julián Montalvo takes on the case, promising to solve it within three days. The investigation soon points toward a dangerous drug cartel. But when the group decides to respond to Montalvo’s threat, it becomes clear that something far darker lies behind them—a history buried for years that is now on the verge of repeating itself. Montalvo has three days to uncover the truth. But by the third day, someone will have to be handed over.

results.title: Night Flower: Inside AIPAC's Fight for Influence
results.original_title: Night Flower: Inside AIPAC's Fight for Influence
results.overview: Is AIPAC acting as a foreign agent for Israel? Is its influence waning? Did it help drag the US into war with Iran? Zeteo’s new hour-long investigation ‘Night Flower’ seeks to answer these questions.

results.title: Agent 67
results.overview: Agent Abdulrahman has spent years counting the war dead and pinning photographs to a wall. In every photo, a pale man in purple watches from the back. That man belongs to the Family, a dynasty that elects one member each generation as the Sadness Prince. When a photograph of the Agency's own lobby turns up, Abdulrahman opens the Book of Agents and summons Ahmed Mazin, Agent 67.

results.title: Dancing For Gold
results.overview: Dancing for Gold follows Laurence Fournier Beaudry and Guillaume Cizeron and Lilah Fear and Lewis Gibson through the Olympic Games they've spent years building towards. From arrival in Milan to their final days in Italy, the film captures the training, the pressure, the partnerships and the raw emotion behind the most artistic event on the Olympic programme.

results.title: ContainMint
results.overview: After a disastrous poker game, DK Brooks steals a case containing $10,000 and mysterious mints, drawing the attention of a ruthless collector who will stop at nothing to get them back.

results.overview: The story of West Michigan's The Rocky Road Shadow Cast.

results.title: Baby Fever
results.overview: A woman struggles to control her transformation into a baby-eating monster at her best friend's baby shower.

results.title: The Playfight
results.overview: Ava and Paul are stuck in a stagnant, competitive relationship when a dinner with a newly infatuated couple sparks an intense power struggle for love and dominance.

results.title: Die Deutschprüfung
results.overview: Far-right voices have gained a majority in Germany and radical nationalist demands for so-called “remigration” have become state policy. Millions of people with migrant backgrounds are being screened and deported if they are not considered German enough – a reality that the friends Sarah and Kim must now face. In the end, only one of them can pass the test.

results.title: Struwwelpeter - Wer nicht hören will, muss fühlen
results.original_title: Struwwelpeter - Wer nicht hören will, muss fühlen
results.overview: When Eli enters her grandmother’s house with her mother Renate for the first time, it quickly becomes clear why she has never met her grandmother. When Eli opens the forbidden cellar door, she not only learns about her mother’s cruel past, but also unleashes Struwwelpeter – and with him the violence inflicted on Renate as a child, embodied in the form of the ill-mannered child that should have stayed in the cellar forever. Struwwelpeter now avenges the past and the injustices of harsh, authoritarian child-rearing.

results.title: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton
results.original_title: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton
results.overview: A celebration of the artist, songwriter, entertainer, humanitarian and entrepreneur whose music and generosity carried her from the mountains of east Tennessee into the hearts of generations around the world.

results.title: Maximini - Zwischen den Tagen
results.overview: After six years in a youth home, 14-year-old Rudi is about to return to Berlin to live with his mother Ruth. A trial weekend is meant to show whether a fresh start is possible and whether Rudi’s wish for a normal life can finally come true. But as they try to reconnect, both are confronted by the wounds of the past. As mother and son struggle to find their place in each other’s lives again, one question becomes more urgent: Can they make it work?
